standard_prerequisites.name: Distinguished triangles from admissible short exact sequences and cones
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, Lemmas lemma-cone-homotopy and lemma-cone-rotate-isom
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies distinguished triangles with cone triangles up to isomorphism and gives the rotated cone triangle; these two facts are what all three axioms are reduced to.

standard_prerequisites.name: Restated axiom (C) under rotation
standard_prerequisites.use: Closes the converse half of TR2: the rotated cone triangle with sign-changed maps is distinguished.

core_obligations: TR1 (proof lines 4504-4515): the triangle (x, x, 0, 1_x, 0, 0) is distinguished because it comes from the admissible short exact sequence x to x to 0, and every morphism alpha : x to y gives the distinguished cone triangle (x, y, c(alpha), alpha, i, -p) by lemma-cone-homotopy.

TR2 (proof lines 4517-4550): a triangle isomorphic to a distinguished one rotates to a triangle isomorphic to the cone triangle of gamma'[-1] by lemma-cone-rotate-isom; the three-row sign-change diagram composes the two isomorphisms of triangles, and lemma-cone-homotopy (2) gives distinguishability; conversely, a distinguished triangle is isomorphic to a cone triangle by lemma-cone-homotopy (1), and its rotation is distinguished by lemma-restate-axiom-c.

TR3 (proof lines 4552-4571): by lemma-cone-homotopy both given distinguished triangles may be replaced by cone triangles of alpha and alpha', and lemma-cone supplies the morphism on the cones completing the commutative diagram.
proof_roadmap: Verify TR1 from the admissible sequence and the cone triangle of an arbitrary morphism.
Verify TR2 in both directions: rotate, compare with the rotated cone triangle via lemma-cone-rotate-isom, compose the sign-changing isomorphisms, and close the converse with lemma-restate-axiom-c.
Verify TR3 by normalizing both triangles to cone triangles and applying lemma-cone.
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies that the homotopy category of the differential graded category of Situation ABC satisfies TR1, TR2 and TR3 (statement lines 4495-4500). The proof (lines 4502-4571) is a genuine diagram chase rather than a citation chain: TR2 alone requires rotating an isomorphism class of triangles, identifying it with the rotated cone triangle through lemma-cone-rotate-isom, composing two isomorphisms of triangles through a three-row diagram with carefully tracked sign changes, and running the converse through the restated axiom (C). H2: the constituent lemmas are cited, but the assembly with sign bookkeeping is the argument and cannot be replaced by any single reference.
